title: Income & Fixed Income
description: Investment income over time (dividends + interest) by year and source, plus your fixed-income holdings — CDs and bonds with rate, maturity, and balance.

widgets.title: Income Over Time
widgets.helpText: Dividends and interest received each year, in the selected currency.

steps.query: SELECT CAST(year AS TEXT) AS year, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN account LIKE 'Income:Dividends%' THEN CAST(amount AS REAL) ELSE 0 END) * -1, 2) AS dividends, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN account LIKE 'Income:Interest%' THEN CAST(amount AS REAL) ELSE 0 END) * -1, 2) AS interest FROM postings WHERE (account LIKE 'Income:Dividends%' OR account LIKE 'Income:Interest%') AND currency = :currency GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

visualization.emptyText: No dividend or interest income in this currency yet.

widgets.title: Income by Source
widgets.helpText: Which accounts your investment income came from, largest first.

steps.query: SELECT account AS source, ROUND(SUM(CAST(amount AS REAL)) * -1, 2) AS amount FROM postings WHERE (account LIKE 'Income:Dividends%' OR account LIKE 'Income:Interest%') AND currency = :currency GROUP BY account HAVING amount != 0 ORDER BY amount DESC

visualization.emptyText: No income sources in this currency yet.

widgets.title: Fixed Income (CDs & Bonds)
widgets.helpText: Your term deposits and bonds — rate and maturity when recorded on the account, and the current balance. Rows without a recorded rate or maturity show a blank.

steps.query: SELECT ab.account AS account, json_extract(a.metadata_json, '$.interest_rate') AS rate, json_extract(a.metadata_json, '$.maturity_date') AS maturity, ROUND(CAST(ab.balance AS REAL), 2) AS balance FROM account_balances ab JOIN accounts a ON a.name = ab.account WHERE (ab.account LIKE 'Assets:Investments:TermDeposits%' OR ab.account LIKE 'Assets:Investments:Bonds%') AND ab.currency = :currency AND CAST(ab.balance AS REAL) != 0 ORDER BY ab.account

visualization.emptyText: No CDs or bonds in this currency. Record them under Assets:Investments with interest_rate and maturity_date metadata to see rate and maturity here.
